notes: GAAP. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p5) Total Governmental Funds column; Insurance Proceeds 17,500 printed under Other Financing Sources is a receipt with outside_printed_total. Issuance of Debt = debt_proceeds; other_financing = Discount on Bonds + Information Technology Subscriptions. 'Taxes' 19,453,131 kept unlabeled: the Statement of Activities breakdown (accrual) totals 19,678,946 and does not tie. Business-type lines from the proprietary statement (p7), Combined Utilities column (internal service fund column excluded); capital contributions and loss on disposal in business_type.other_financing; business-type totals summed (no single printed total). ending_cash = pooled cash/investments plus cash at county treasurer from the governmental funds balance sheet (p4). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position, 2024 Totals column; it is off by 1 (rounding) as printed. Detail: budgetary-basis budget-and-actual schedules for General, City Highway Allocation, American Rescue Plan, eight nonmajor special revenue funds, Capital Construction, Special Assessments and Debt Service (function lines only, not itemized); Community Development Agency from the nonmajor combining statement (p12, no budget schedule), other nonmajor columns not recorded from p12 to avoid double counting; utilities by division from the combining departmental schedule (p18). Pages 1, 9 (cash flow continuation), 19 (combining cash flows) and 20-22 (statistical tables) have no detail lines. Read pages 1-22 of 22
